crossRefs.note: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for…
He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

people.name: Ebed
people.line: Father of Gaal, who opposed Abimelech's rule

people.name: Gaal
people.line: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brothers and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Gaal son of Ebed came with his brothers and crossed into Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem put their confidence in him.
translations.kjv: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence
translations.asv: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their trust in him.
